title: Retry transient sharing failures when the launcher captures the Dart reporter digest
outcome: At stage close, give a digest-bearing capture a bounded chance to recover from a temporary Windows sharing error while retaining the run-owned file, size and digest fences.
acceptance: A runner fixture that briefly holds the owned report at stage close yields its actual digest after release. A missing, changed, oversized or still unreadable report supplies no artifact evidence. Bound the retry and keep process exit precedence.
